title: Business English Conversation 18:  Reporting Missing Luggage
content: 1. to report lost luggage: to tell the authorities (usually the airline) that one's luggage is missing - I reported my lost luggage to the airline and they helped me. - She reported lost luggage, but the airline couldn't find it. 2. to fill out a form: to write all of the information in the blanks on an official piece of paper - If you want to get a loan, then you have to fill out many forms. - Please fill out this form, sir. 3. to contact someone: to call, message, or email a person - I will contact my client and tell them that we need to reschedule the meeting. - Please contact me once you decide.
